title: Add typed campaign overlay lore records
description:
Add campaign overlay lore records to campaign state/storage.

These records capture consequential improvised facts created during play. They must be queryable and auditable, but should not replace read-only module canon.

Suggested shape, adjust during implementation:

WorldFact:
- id
- kind: rumor | clue | npc_detail | location_detail | quest_hook | threat_report | scene_consequence | player_created_detail | other
- subjectId or subjectText
- locationId optional
- npcId optional
- factionId optional
- text/fact
- truthStatus
- source: dm_improvised | player_declared | module_derived | tool_result | consequence
- scope: scene | session | campaign
- visibility: player_visible | dm_only | mixed
- introducedAtTurnId/sessionId
- supersedes/invalidates optional
- tags optional

Acceptance criteria:
- Campaign overlay lore has a typed schema.
- Records can be persisted in campaign state/checkpoints.
- Records are append-friendly and auditable.
- Records can be invalidated or superseded without destructive rewriting.
- Records can distinguish player-visible knowledge from DM-only truth.
- Tests cover serialization/deserialization and checkpoint persistence.
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
